name: Nicole Gerome
fact: The Talisman knows one student of this surname across two volumes and spells her given name both ways: the 1993 index reads "Gerome, Nicole 194" and the 1994 index "Gerome, Nicki, 63", where she is printed as Nicki Gerome Jr. of Hendersonville, Tennessee, a Phi Mu. The archive carries a Nicole Gerome in 1991-92 and a Nicki Jerome in 1992-93; on the Talisman's evidence those are very probably one student entered twice under two spellings, in the same way Settles is entered twice in 2015-16.

src.label: 1994 Talisman, p. 63, Phi Mu portraits; 1993 Talisman index

name: Andrea Cailles
fact: She was a freshman from Floyds Knobs, Indiana in 1991-92. The Talisman indexes exactly one Cailles, as Andrea D. in 1992 and Andrea in 1993, so the archive's Andrea Cailles of 1992-93 and Andi Cailles of 1993-94 are very probably the same student entered twice.

name: Amy McCloud
fact: She was a freshman from Hendersonville, Tennessee in 1988-89 and is in the Talisman every year to 1991, indexed McCloud, Amy in 1989, McCloud, Amy E. in 1990 and 1991. Only one student of that name appears, so the archive's Amy McLoud of 1988-89 and Amy McCloud of 1989-90 are very probably the same person: she was a freshman in the first of those years.

src.label: 1989 Talisman, p. 147; 1990 Talisman, p. 227; 1991 Talisman, p. 195

name: LauraLee Wilson
fact: The 1992 Talisman gave her a two-page profile, "Mom trades housework for homework". She was a non-traditional student with a husband and a young son, taking the pre-medical course, and the books photographed in front of her are College Physics, Organic Chemistry, Complete Preparation for the MCAT and The Science of Genetics. Story by Carol Overby, photographs by Chuck Wing.

name: Erica Card
fact: The 1989 Talisman gave her one of its "Images of" profiles, headed "Gambling for peace". She was a Hopkinsville freshman who had spent the previous eight years at an army base school in Germany where her father was stationed, chose Western because it offered Russian and had a small-college atmosphere, and was active in United Campuses to Prevent Nuclear War without holding office in it. Story by Marsha Burton, photograph by Patti Longmire.

name: Curtis Finley
fact: The 1992 Talisman's feature on married students, "Taking their vows to class", carries him as Curt Finley, a London senior, aged 23 and married to Kirsten Finley, a junior from Ft. Lauderdale, Florida. The couple decided to marry after a four-hour telephone conversation one September night. Story by Cheryl A. Edwards, photographs by Marc Piscotty.

name: Syed Ahsan
fact: The 1992 Talisman index entry "Ahsan, S. Reza 148" is not the student. p. 148 of that volume is a faculty page and the sitter is S. Reza Ahsan, professor of geography and geology. A later researcher should not follow it. The student is indexed separately, "Ahsan, Syed" at 1990 p. 182 and 1993 p. 194, both organization pages with no portrait.

name: Tim Jaynes
fact: The Talisman spells him Janes, not Jaynes, in all three volumes that carry him. He was a Greensburg senior reading government, philosophy and religion in 1989-90, and the 1990 index puts him on p. 162, the Associated Student Government spread, alongside his senior portrait on p. 86.

name: Maya Pettries
fact: The Talisman spells her Petties in all four volumes that carry her, never Pettries: 1991 p. 180, 1992 p. 223, 1993 p. 52 and 1994 p. 61. She was from Radcliff, a junior in 1992-93, and a member of Delta Sigma Theta, whose 1993-94 chapter block on p. 61 of the 1994 volume reads Baggarly, Campbell, Mills, Petties and Wright.

name: Melissa Baggarly
fact: She was a senior from Hartford in 1993-94 and a member of Delta Sigma Theta, appearing in the chapter's portrait block in the 1994 Talisman beside Paula E. Campbell, Deanna L. Mills, Maya Petties and Shlonda Wright.

name: Paige VanMeter
fact: The 1994 Talisman prints her as Paige Van Meter, two words, a sophomore from Louisville, and places her in the Chi Omega portrait block; she wears the chapter's letters in the portrait. The 1993 volume indexes her the archive's way, VanMeter, at p. 178.

name: Kathleen Young
fact: She was a senior from Lexington in 1993-94 and a member of Kappa Delta, the last name in that chapter's portrait block in the 1994 Talisman before the Phi Mu rule.

name: Christopher Roberts
fact: He was a senior from Paducah in 1993-94 and lived in Rodes-Harlin Hall, which is how the 1994 Talisman groups its portrait grids. Sam Sharbutt, a senior from Franklin, Tennessee, is the name immediately after his in the same block, so the two SGA members of 1992-93 were photographed side by side.

name: Emily Brown
fact: She was from White House, Tennessee. The 1992 Talisman carries her as Emily E. Brown, a freshman, on the underclassmen grid on p. 117, and the 1994 volume as Emily Brown, a senior, on the McLean Hall grid on p. 31; the shared home town ties the two entries together.

name: Heather Hall
fact: She was a freshman from Bowling Green in 1990-91, which is what makes the archive's 1993-94 service her senior year. The Talisman carries her as Heather N. Hall in 1991, 1992 and 1993, and indexes no second Heather Hall in any of them.

name: Darla Roof
fact: An archive defect worth recording. The 1989 Talisman index gives her one page, 149, and gives Daryl Pepper the same page. In the digitised file p. 149 is the full-page photograph of Travis Holtrey that closes an "Images of" feature, and the freshman portrait grid that should carry surnames N to R sits nowhere in the scan: the grids run Lagerman-Moore on p. 147 and resume at Spencer-Wantland on p. 150, with the Holtrey spread between them. Two SGA members are unreachable because of it.

name: Bobbi Petersen
fact: She was a sophomore from Owensboro in 1989-90. Her portrait sits in one of the short rows on p. 121 of the 1990 Talisman, where a full-page intramural photograph takes up the lower left of the page and the last three rows of the grid carry only two portraits each.

name: Susan Mitchell
fact: An earlier pass wrote her off on the strength of the 1993 index, which gives her only organization pages. The 1990 volume does carry her class portrait, on p. 119, where she is a sophomore from Lebanon, Tennessee. The Talisman has her every year from 1989 to 1993, so the sophomore of 1989-90 is the administrative vice president of 1992-93.

name: Alan Thomason
fact: The 1993 Talisman index gives him p. 44 as "Thomason, Alan", and the same senior grid page carries Vicki Vowell, whose entry adds p. 198. Both were photographed in the Stark-Vowell block of the senior grid, so the two 1990s SGA members sit in the same twenty portraits.
